method.cold: No settle time: wait for the load event, then sort as soon as each header button exists.
method.settled: Wait for the network to go idle, then 1.5 s, before each step (the first sort, the berth sorts, and the scroll to the berths).
method.window: Each visit ends 5 s after the last sort's visible change. Long-task time covers navigation through that end point, so the sorts count as work in the window.
method.overrun: Sum of (duration - 50 ms) over every long task in the window. Previously called blocking time.
method.tbt: Sum of (duration - 50 ms) over long tasks that start at or after First Contentful Paint and before the first sort's pointerdown, so it measures the load and not the sorts. There's no TTI to end the window, because the visits don't idle for 5 s before sorting (Lighthouse dropped TTI in version 10). This window leans toward islands, which put off their work until the first interaction, so compare pages by long-task time and the sort timings, and read TBT as the cost of the load alone.
method.visible: Time from pointerdown to the first frame after aria-sort changes on the target header, as before.
method.event: Largest Event Timing duration among entries that start at or after the pointerdown, with durationThreshold 16 ms. Interactions under 16 ms are not reported, so they are recorded as 0. Chromium only.
method.bytes: Chromium: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength, with the main document counted as HTML. Firefox and WebKit: Playwright request.sizes(), response body plus response headers.
method.statistics: Medians use the true median. IQR is Q3 minus Q1 with linear interpolation. Intervals are percentile bootstrap 95% intervals over 2000 resamples, seeded with the seed above; difference intervals resample each group separately.
